answer: The wander holds work receipts rather than names, so the knoll of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The violet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, clawed back after a replayed submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
